baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins intentional works, ash, an intensifying wind, and inability to exercise power over anything earned.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate production and acquisition are converted into already-burned particulate and then exposed to a force defined by dispersal. The failure is not inactivity but non-retention: output remains only in a form that cannot be gathered, possessed, or deployed.

activation_trace.role: Intentional action supplies the deliberately produced input whose durability the simile tests.
Burned ash supplies residue already deprived of its source substance and serves as the unstable asset-state.
Moving air supplies the carrier that removes the particulate output from its producers.
A violent dispersing wind supplies the winnowing force that makes retention impossible.
Effective capacity and possession supply the control explicitly denied to the earners.
Seeking and obtaining benefit supplies the acquisition whose usable value collapses.

changed_reading.before: The verse says that the deeds receive no reward.
changed_reading.after: The verse models productive effort whose asset-state collapses: deliberate earning becomes residue over which the earners have no executable control.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The actors cover or deny in relation to their Lord before their works are described as ash.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory behind the Lord anchor supplies both governing completion and nutritive growth. Covering received benefit disconnects intentional work from the relation that owns, feeds, and brings it to completion, leaving an infertile terminal residue.

activation_trace.role: Concealing or withholding recognition of benefit supplies the relational breach.
Care, repair, and completion supply the process from which the works are detached.
The non-dominant growth target supplies feeding and development as a second dimension of the severed relation.
Purposeful work supplies a real production process rather than mere passivity.
The destruction-and-barrenness branch turns ash into the infertile endpoint of failed maturation.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief only identifies whose works are compared with ash.
changed_reading.after: Disbelief in the sustaining Lord becomes a production defect: work is detached from the relation that could nurture and complete it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The physical removal of ash is immediately named as far straying.
baseline_models.mechanism: The simile makes distance operational. Violent dispersal converts a moral direction-word into the condition of an asset that has gone missing beyond retrieval, so the closing distance is the enacted result of the preceding loss.

activation_trace.role: A descriptive report licenses the material scene as a state-description of the actors' works.
Forceful scattering supplies the physical transition from possession to irretrievability.
Loss of a thing supplies the missing-property sense enacted by the ash.
Distance from nearness supplies the condition that prevents recovery.
Denied effective capacity converts remoteness from description into practical helplessness.

changed_reading.before: Far only intensifies the degree of moral error.
changed_reading.after: Far names the operational state of earnings dispersed beyond location, recovery, and use; the moral distance is materially enacted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier occurrence of the same closing formula follows an active sequence of blocking a traversable route and seeking crookedness in it. The focus image then reads as the terminal material state of route sabotage: repeated deflection produces works that have no recoverable direction or destination.

activation_trace.role: Departure from guidance and aim anchors the focus close in route failure.
Remoteness supplies the resulting separation from a recoverable course.
Turning away and diverting supply an active blocking operation rather than accidental loss.
An extended traversable way supplies the route being obstructed.
Semantic deviation from straightness supplies deliberate distortion of the route's meaning and aim.
The repeated straying branch names the outcome of the obstruction sequence.
The repeated distance branch ties that engineered route failure directly to the focus close.

structural_cues: 14:3 ends with the same two-root far-straying formula as 14:18 after preference, obstruction, and sought crookedness.
14:18 changes the earlier route sequence into a particulate scene of irreversible dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a blocked path, sought crookedness, and the repeated far-straying close; I supply the arrow from route sabotage to ash-like loss of direction. A live alternative is that 14:18 repeats the formula without making the works themselves path-like.

changed_reading.before: The ash is a free-standing image of lost reward.
changed_reading.after: The scattered works are the terminal state of repeatedly bending and blocking a route: conduct manufactures the distance called far straying.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah supplies a reciprocal growth system and then two arboreal production models: recognition leads to increase; a sound tree has a stable base and recurring yield; a corrupt tree is removed from its base and has no settlement. Against that system, the focus works are not merely destroyed goods but production severed from root, nurture, and durable yield.

activation_trace.role: Withheld recognition of benefit supplies the negative side of the growth reciprocity.
Care and completion supply the governing cultivation relation denied by the actors.
Feeding and growth make maturation, rather than mere ownership, part of the focus anchor.
Barrenness and destruction supply the failed-yield state opposed to the later rooted tree.
Recognition of benefit and its giver supplies the relation paired with increase.
Increase and growth supply the positive developmental outcome withheld from the focus works.
A base or root supplies the attachment required for durable production.
Continuance and stability supply the condition under which yield can recur.
Removal of a thing together with its root supplies the negative production model closest to ash dispersal.
Stability and settlement supply exactly what the uprooted model and the focus ash lack.

structural_cues: 14:7 couples recognition with increase and covered benefit with severity.
14:24-25 moves from stable base to elevated branch to recurring yield by the Lord's permission.
14:26 reverses that chain with total uprooting and no settlement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognition, growth, root stability, recurring yield, uprooting, and no settlement; I infer that relation to the Lord functions as the cultivation condition of works. A live alternative is that ash denotes destruction only after judgment rather than failed maturation throughout the works' life.

changed_reading.before: The works become ash only because a later storm destroys them.
changed_reading.after: The works enter judgment already as failed yield: detached from nurture and root, they cannot mature into stable, recurring benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, every secondary conversion channel closes. Followers cannot obtain sufficiency from leaders, the inviter disclaims coercive authority and mutual rescue, and the day admits neither exchange nor intimate alliance. The earned works therefore function as capital with zero convertibility across patronage, power, market, and friendship.

activation_trace.role: Effective capacity and possession anchor the model in the control denied by the focus.
Acquired benefit supplies the apparent capital whose conversion is tested.
A determinate thing supplies the minimal unit of relief that cannot be secured.
Allegiance and sequential loyalty supply the patronage relation expected to transfer protection.
Sufficiency supplies the relief that leaders prove unable to provide even in the smallest amount.
Power and delegated authority supply the coercive channel explicitly denied to the inviter.
A verbal call supplies the limited input that replaces any claim of compulsion or transferable power.
Exchange for a price supplies the market channel declared unavailable on the day.
Intimate affection supplies the relational channel that cannot substitute for exchange.
The non-dominant split target adds release from liability as another unavailable form of exit.

structural_cues: 14:21 echoes the focus's minimal-thing construction inside a failed request for leaders to remove any portion of punishment.
14:22 reduces the misleading agent's contribution to invitation followed by voluntary response and denies mutual rescue.
14:31 removes both sale and intimate alliance on the day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed sufficiency, absent coercive authority, and closed exchange and alliance; I infer that the focus treats earnings as nonconvertible capital. A live alternative is that each scene independently describes helplessness without forming one transfer system.

changed_reading.before: The earners simply cannot retrieve physically scattered ash.
changed_reading.after: They cannot convert earned effort into relief through patronage, authority, market, friendship, or discharge; its social exchange value is zero.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later accounting language separates beneficial availability from evidentiary persistence. The works are outside the earners' control, but they are not left unmarked: intentional acts remain available to counting and exact recompense. Ash therefore marks loss of asset value without loss of liability.

activation_trace.role: Burned residue anchors the apparent annihilation that the later account qualifies.
Denied control specifies that what is lost is the earners' usable command.
Acquisition anchors the same earnings later subjected to recompense.
Counting and account supply a day on which acts remain numerically available.
Negated omission or lack of marking supplies an explicit refusal of unrecorded disappearance.
The repeated intentional-work category links divine attention to the focus works.
Action met by its corresponding recompense supplies persistence of consequence.
The exact earning root from the focus reappears as the object of individual recompense.
Rapid accounting closes the sequence with no loss of record despite loss of benefit.

structural_cues: 14:42 negates divine inattention to what wrongdoers intentionally do and states that delay lasts until a specified day.
14:51 repeats earning as the direct object of recompense for every self and closes with rapid accounting.
14:18 denies the earners' capacity over their earnings; it does not say the account loses those earnings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies unusable scattered works, negated omission, and recompense for the same earning category; I supply the asset-liability asymmetry. A live alternative is that ash denotes total annulment of positive value while the record preserves only attribution, not the deeds in any substantive sense.

changed_reading.before: Ash means that the deeds simply cease to exist.
changed_reading.after: Ash names loss of beneficial command, not deletion from account: what cannot serve as an asset remains fully available as liability.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the focus ash against the later uncultivated valley rather than only against punishment. It remains valid through the focus branches of barrenness and nurture and the packet's local cultivation, provision, fruit, and recognition sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a contrastive test showing that material barrenness need not determine yield, not as a claim that 14:18 directly refers to the valley.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The works are barren ash specifically in relation to denial of their nurturing Lord.

activation_trace.role: Destruction and barrenness make the ash available as an infertile outcome.
Feeding and growth anchor fertility in a sustaining relation rather than in terrain alone.
Cultivation and growth supply the expressly absent natural condition in the valley.
Allocated provision supplies an outcome requested despite the absent cultivation.
Mature fruit supplies the positive yield that environmental barrenness alone cannot predict.
Recognition of benefit and giver closes the requested provision cycle and contrasts focus denial.

changed_reading.after: The later barren valley can still receive fruit, so the decisive infertility of the focus works is relational rather than environmental.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from meteorology to interior anthropology. It remains anchored in the focus wind-and-ash mechanism and in the later predicate of air or void for hearts. Downstream prose should qualify it as an imagistic internalization, not identify the two roots or claim that the focus explicitly describes hearts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus works are particulate carried by moving air; later the packet predicates air or void of hearts.

activation_trace.role: Moving air supplies the external medium in which the works fail to settle.
Light burned residue supplies the material susceptible to that medium.
Air and emptiness, predicated of hearts in the source sentence, supply an interior medium without solidity.

changed_reading.before: The wind is only an external destructive force.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the later hollow heart internalizes the dispersing medium: works cannot settle because their producers also lack interior density.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it places particulate ash against mountain mass and apparent world-moving strategy. It remains anchored through the focus's denied capacity and dominant wind and through the local oath, removal, and mountain branches. Downstream prose should render it as a scale reversal while preserving the grammatical uncertainty over whether the mountain clause grants hypothetical efficacy or denies actual efficacy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The actors cannot control even ash-like earnings, while the later plotting clause is framed at the scale of mountain displacement.

activation_trace.role: Fine burned residue supplies the smallest, lightest mass the actors still cannot retain.
Wind as force and dominance supplies the superior agency that defeats their control.
Denied effective capacity anchors the reversal in the focus construction.
A distributed oath supplies the actors' prior certainty about non-removal.
Removal from place or state supplies the displacement they had denied for themselves.
The repeated removal branch scales displacement up inside the plotting clause.
A high solid mass supplies the maximal stability contrasted with wind-borne ash.

changed_reading.before: Worthless works imply that the actors never exercise consequential power.
changed_reading.after: The packet permits a harsher scale reversal: strategy may appear mountain-sized, yet before the dominant force its producers cannot retain even the ash of their own output.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant mapped target from the recompense root at 14:51. It remains anchored because that ayah directly repeats earning while the split branches supply cutting-time and fallen yield, which reconnect to focus ash and failed cultivation. Downstream prose must label this a split-root exploratory image, not a lexical gloss of the recompense verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus turns earned works into residue, and 14:51 returns to the same earning category under recompense.

activation_trace.role: Burned residue anchors the failed-yield material at the focus.
Acquired benefit supplies the production category carried into the later account.
Corresponding recompense supplies the dominant accounting mechanism.
The non-dominant split target supplies harvest-time or the moment of cutting as an exploratory audit image.
What falls during cutting supplies an exploratory residue parallel to the focus ash.
The repeated earning root keeps the harvest image attached to the exact focus category.

changed_reading.before: The later recompense verse confirms only an abstract account.
changed_reading.after: At an explicitly exploratory split-root level, accounting also resembles harvest and cutting: what was earned is exposed as fallen residue rather than usable yield.

strongest_changes: The repeated far-straying close turns ash dispersal into the endpoint of actively engineered route distortion.
Recognition, increase, stable roots, and recurring yield revise ash into a failed growth cycle detached from nurture.
Failed patronage, denied authority, and absent exchange make the earnings nonconvertible rather than merely missing.
Later attention, recompense, and counting separate loss of beneficial control from preservation of liability.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly refunctionalized the ash: engineered distance, anti-yield, illiquid capital, and finally an asset-liability asymmetry. The packet's split targets also preserved a contained harvest-residue activation that a conservative synthesis would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from denial of the Lord to failed maturation is coherent but inferred; the text may instead juxtapose relation and outcome without specifying a production process.
The social and market scenes may be parallel instances of helplessness rather than one integrated conversion system.
The inner-air, mountain-scale, barren-valley, and split-root harvest readings should remain qualified activations rather than lexical or referential claims.
